description: Update the codebase to remove support for Python 3.10, which reaches end-of-life in October 2024. This change will allow the project to leverage newer Python features and simplify maintenance by focusing on currently supported Python versions. The implementation should update all relevant configuration files, documentation, and code checks.
functional_requirements: Update the project configuration to set the minimum supported Python version to 3.11
Modify CI/CD workflows to remove Python 3.10 from testing matrices and update version checks
Update all documentation references to reflect the new minimum Python version requirement
